pain.title: Fewer than half of car theory tests are passed
pain.text: The test covers 14 topics, from road signs and stopping distances to documents and first aid, and you have to pass both the multiple-choice questions and hazard perception. Visual maps help you see each topic at a glance and remember the details that trip people up.
pain.source: 44.8% of car theory tests in Great Britain were passed between April 2025 and March 2026 (DVSA statistics).

items.a: Anyone preparing for the car theory test in Great Britain, especially if your test is coming up soon, you learn better with visuals, or you need to revise quickly after a fail.

This is version {version}. Each map is checked against The Highway Code and official GOV.UK guidance, and the date of the check is printed on every page ({checkedOn}). When the rules or the test change, we update the PDFs and you get the new version free.
No. It's an independent revision guide based on The Highway Code and official public guidance. All the practice questions are our own, not taken from the official question bank.
It's designed for the theory test in Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales). Where the rules differ between England, Scotland and Wales, the maps say so.
Right after you pay, Hotmart emails you your access to the members area, where you download the PDFs.
Yes. Every map is an A4 page, made to print in colour or black and white.

items.q: Does it work on my phone or tablet?
items.a: Yes, the PDFs open on any device. They're designed for A4, so they're most comfortable on a tablet or printed; on a phone, zoom in. The flashcards also come in a phone version.
Yes, the Complete pack includes a visual guide to how hazards are scored and what to look for. You'll still need to practise with video clips.
No. They're high-resolution PDFs for your personal use.
Yes. You have {guaranteeDays} days from your purchase to ask for a full refund through Hotmart, no questions asked.
